title: DataProf Quality Policy
description: Validation contract for dataprof quality gate policies (--policy FILE). Validates accepted keys, types, ranges, dimension vocabularies, and scopes. Runtime rules not enforced by this schema: (1) At least one quality requirement must be stated; policies stating no requirement (e.g. empty, or containing only scope or forbid_added_columns: false) raise a validation error when executed by check(). (2) Rules about change (max_quality_score_drop, max_dimension_score_drops, max_null_percentage_increase, forbid_removed_columns: true, forbid_added_columns: true) require a baseline report (--baseline PATH). (3) Whole numbers written with a decimal point (e.g. 1.0) are rejected as counts at runtime. (4) The $schema key is not permitted in policy files because additionalProperties is false.

min_rows.description: Minimum row count required for the source.

min_quality_score.description: Minimum overall data quality score required (0 to 100).

max_null_percentage.description: Maximum allowable null percentage per column (0 to 100), or a mapping from column name to limit with '*' as fallback.

max_duplicate_rows.description: Maximum allowable count of duplicate rows.

require_metrics.description: Required metric packs or dimensions that must be computed.

require_columns.description: Required column names that must exist in the dataset.

max_quality_score_drop.description: Maximum allowed drop in overall quality score relative to baseline (0 to 100).

max_dimension_score_drops.description: Maximum allowed score drops per quality dimension relative to baseline.

max_null_percentage_increase.description: Maximum allowed increase in null percentage relative to baseline (0 to 100), or a mapping from column name to limit with '*' as fallback.

forbid_removed_columns.description: Whether to fail the gate if any baseline column is missing from the source.

forbid_added_columns.description: Whether to fail the gate if the source contains columns not present in the baseline.

Percentage.description: A score or percentage threshold between 0.0 and 100.0.

Count.description: A non-negative whole-number count up to 2^64 - 1.

DimensionScoreMap.description: Mapping from quality dimension names to percentage thresholds.

PerColumnPercentage.description: A percentage ceiling across all columns or a per-column map where '*' is the fallback ceiling for other columns.
